title: observability: token/KV metrics, tracing span enhancements, dashboards, and alert tuning
author: Maya Chen
description: This PR adds new token-level KV cache metrics, enhances tracing spans for cache hits/misses, updates Grafana dashboard panels for token-level cost/latency breakdowns, and tunes alerts to reduce noise while preserving SLO coverage. Motivation: provide better visibility into per-token serving costs and KV cache effectiveness to drive batching and autoscaler decisions and to make cost regressions actionable. Key changes include: exporting token_cost_per_request and token_latency_by_bucket to Prometheus; adding kv_cache_hit_ratio and kv_cache_latency histograms; propagating cache.hit/cache.miss attributes and model/route tags on tracing spans; adding dashboard heatmaps, per-model token-cost and latency breakdown panels, and drilldowns from route->model->token-bucket; adjusting alert thresholds to use p95/p99 token latency and adding a burn-rate style alert for token-level cost regressions. Rollout is gated behind FEATURE_FLAG_TOKEN_METRICS and will follow staged rollout: enable on staging, run smoke queries and dashboard QA, then gradual ramp on hosted with canary percentage and monitor. Backwards compatibility: metrics are opt-in, tracing additions are additive. Testing: unit tests for metric names and tag propagation, integration tests against local Prometheus+Jaeger, and manual dashboard verification. Checklist: [x] unit tests added [x] integration smoke [x] docs updated [x] SRE alerted for alert tuning review.
